Power Structure and Integration Lead said about it: The 2025 NASA Lunabotics First Place Finish machine at 120 lb mass from the Sebastion | Engineering (E39) and the same win from the Sebastion | Engineering (E40) shows a 50 kg class digger is buildable, and the mass sum against the 60 kg limit (E41) is 47.0 kg leaving 13.0 kg margin, about a fifth of an adult body weight spare, so everyday scale says the limit is met.
Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead said about it: I take from the Advanced Edge Detection of AprilTags for Precise Docking Maneuvers of Mobile Robots (E54) the finding that tag-guided docking reaches about 4.5 cm deviation, which from chassis view means creep positioning to 0.030 m to 0.040 m at 1.00 m to 2.00 m from the fiducial final-align error budget and stall current backout timing (E58) is within skid-steer creep capability if final trim is done at 0.100 m per s, and I take from the Sebastion | Engineering (E39) the precedent that a 120 lb, meaning about 54.4 kg, winner sits at the same person-scale mass as our 46.0 kg from the updated mass sum (E62), so our wheel load and pressure regime is proven buildable.

statements.text: The 2025 NASA Lunabotics First Place Finish machine at 120 lb mass from the Sebastion | Engineering (E39) and the same win from the Sebastion | Engineering (E40) shows a 50 kg class digger is buildable, and the mass sum against the 60 kg limit (E41) is 47.0 kg leaving 13.0 kg margin, about a fifth of an adult body weight spare, so everyday scale says the limit is met.

I take from the Advanced Edge Detection of AprilTags for Precise Docking Maneuvers of Mobile Robots (E54) the finding that tag-guided docking reaches about 4.5 cm deviation, which from chassis view means creep positioning to 0.030 m to 0.040 m at 1.00 m to 2.00 m from the fiducial final-align error budget and stall current backout timing (E58) is within skid-steer creep capability if final trim is done at 0.100 m per s, and I take from the Sebastion | Engineering (E39) the precedent that a 120 lb, meaning about 54.4 kg, winner sits at the same person-scale mass as our 46.0 kg from the updated mass sum (E62), so our wheel load and pressure regime is proven buildable.
